items.title: File Widerspruch against Gefahrklasse assessment
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft, Gerüstweg 7, 30159 Musterhannover.
items.computation: Letter dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday), presumed handed to the post the same day. The letter itself states (and current §37 Abs. 2 SGB X, as amended for the 2025 postal-service reform, confirms) that notice is deemed given on the 4th day after posting: 19.11.+4 days = 23.11.2026, which is a Sunday. Under the statutory rule, if that day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, notice is deemed given on the next Werktag, i.e. Monday 24.11.2026 (today). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (24.11.) is not counted, the period starts 25.11.2026, and a 'month' ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (24.11. -> 24.12.). 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a statutory holiday in NW, so no further shift is needed.
